description: On-demand live webcam for the owner's exact Ditoo Plus. The owner launches it; the MCP dashboard (Runtime 003) is suspended for exactly as long as the Studio window is open and restored when it closes.

behavior.session_ids: OPENDITOO-WEBCAM-LIVE-<run nonce 8 hex>-<seq 3 digits>, fresh per session, durable one-use claim taken only against the Studio's per-session nonce; the Host ledger independently consumes each id
behavior.stop: Stop button, window close or Ctrl+C end the launch; camera fault, stall, Host refusal/fault, ACK timeout, any unknown outcome, policy revocation or hash drift end the launch with no retry; 30 min / 60 sessions per launch
behavior.scheduler: W10 absolute-deadline scheduler, max mode: 50 ms slots, 50 ms client floor over the 40 ms Host streaming floor, missed slots skipped, duplicate/unchanged frames not sent, heartbeat on a quiet scene

evidence.W10-001: transport PASS + owner visual PASS (500 frames, 16.458 fps ACKed transport)
evidence.W10-002: operator Stop + live zoom/pan PASS (290 frames)
evidence.not_yet_exercised: back-to-back session rollover on the real device (dry-run only); first policy launch will be its evidence

install.launcher: scripts/webcam_on_demand.sh (desktop shortcut runs it through wsl.exe)
install.revocation: python3 host/webcam_studio.py policy-revoke moves the local policy to .openditoo-local/revoked/ marked revoked

authority.grant_scope_requested: Standing on-demand webcam authority until revoked: whenever the owner launches the webcam, suspend Runtime 003, then stream the live N980P webcam through the W10 Studio to exact Ditoo 11:75:58:CE:DE:C7 v42012 via the existing typed Host 127.0.0.1:8796 (streaming_ack_clock profile, 40 ms Host floor, 50 ms client floor) as back-to-back sessions of at most 60 s and 500 frames / 1500 packets / 527000 application bytes each, one connection and one frame in flight per session, each under a fresh one-use id; continue only after a clean budget or lifetime end, stop on anything else with no retry/reconnect/reclaim/pipelining; at most 30 min / 60 sessions per launch; restore Runtime 003 on exit. Does not start by itself, does not widen Runtime 003, grants no raw send, target selection, firmware or persistence, and does not revive any W7-W10 experiment grant.
